_comment: Every RLCS LAN the page can show. Hand-maintained, the way data/teams.json is,
but deliberately thin: the display name, city, venue, dates, team count and
prize pool all come from the Infobox at the top of the Liquipedia page itself
(parseInfobox in parseBracket.mjs). Copying those here by hand is how a config
goes stale. All this file has to say is which page to read.
slug:    stable id, used in the URL hash and as the teams-<slug>.json name.
titles:  the Liquipedia pages that define the brackets. A LAN is one page;
a regional Open would be four or five subpages.
cache:   the on-disk copy under cache/. It doubles as the collector's
last-good output: a failed fetch leaves the previous copy and the
page keeps rendering yesterday's truth rather than nothing.
starts / ends:  OPTIONAL override of the infobox dates, only needed for an
event whose page has no infobox dates yet. The collector makes
requests only inside this window, padded a day either side. How
FAST it polls inside it comes from the match times, not from here.
Adding the next LAN: find the page under
add four lines here, run `node collect.mjs --once`, then
`node resolveTeams.mjs "<page title>" <slug>` for the real team names.
